verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge runs inside your own Mastra server: scopes are passed by "your server", it runs locally via `mastra dev`, and it stores its data in your configured storage provider by adding `mastra_knowledge_*` tables. That points to running on infrastructure you control. However, nothing in the evidence states the code is open source or describes a Docker or production self-hosting path. missing for 10: explicit open-source licensing/code availability, Docker or container deployment documentation, production self-host deployment guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the memory layer from open-source code (e.g. via Docker) on infrastructure I control

citations.quote: Knowledge is stored in your configured storage provider, which adds its own `mastra_knowledge_*` tables the first time Knowledge is used
the scopes your server passes for a run decide which ones it can read
To see the page, run `mastra dev`, open Studio and select **Knowledge**.
